verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gitea code review supports the Pull Request workflow (and AGit). They also say reviewers can browse code online and leave review comments, and submitters can respond or modify code online, which covers the core of opening a PR and reviewing it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of diff comparison views, explicit confirmation that comments are anchored inline to code lines, independent/hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience.
